parameters.content:
## Lab 06: Run Quality Review and Human-in-the-Loop Approval

**Input:** data/mock-data.xlsx

**Output:** review-register.xlsx, repair-log.json and approval-ledger.json

**Acceptance:** No high-severity finding remains open; reviewer, timestamp, decision and payload_hash are recorded; the hash is rechecked immediately before release.

TRAINING SAFETY: synthetic data; credentials remain in n8n; external publishing stays dry-run/private until trainer authorization.
